answer_json.answer: You cannot directly delete photos from your phone without also deleting them from iCloud when using iCloud Photo Library, because it syncs all devices. Instead, enable 'Optimize iPhone Storage' in Settings > iCloud > Photos to keep smaller versions on your phone while full-resolution originals remain in iCloud. Alternatively, use a third-party service like Dropbox to back up photos before deleting them from your phone.

To delete photos from your iPhone without deleting them from iCloud, disable iCloud Photo Library. Go to Settings > iCloud > Photos and turn off iCloud Photo Library. Your photos will remain in iCloud but be removed from your device.

If iCloud Photo Library is enabled, deleting photos from your iPhone will also delete them from iCloud. To avoid this, you can disable iCloud Photo Library (Settings > Photos > iCloud Photo Library: off) and then delete photos from your phone. However, this will stop syncing. Alternatively, use a third-party service like Dropbox or Google Photos to back up your photos before deleting them from your phone.

This keeps the full-resolution originals in iCloud while storing smaller, device-optimized versions on your phone, freeing up space without deleting from iCloud.
